key_insight: QF3 speeds up reinforcement learning for flow policies by combining flow matching with critic-guided action gradients, while filtering updates to keep training stable and useful. This lets robots improve from interaction more efficiently than standard flow-policy RL.
problem_solved: The paper tackles the challenge of making flow policies better through online reinforcement learning without unstable or inefficient updates. It addresses how to improve pretrained flow policies or learn them from scratch using critic feedback in a fast, off-policy setting.
method: Train a flow policy with standard flow matching to preserve the policy's generative structure.
Add the critic's action gradient as a learning signal, backpropagated through a one-step prediction of the flow output.
Filter gradients so updates are applied only where they are reliable or beneficial, improving stability and sample efficiency.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, QF3 offers a practical way to make flow-based robot policies learn faster from interaction while staying stable. It is especially useful when demonstration-trained policies need further improvement in real-world or simulated control tasks.
